model_label_policy.reason: Neither family is assumed true, and relative preference cannot replace absolute predictive adequacy.

required_model_families.semantics: A fully specified known-body, intrinsic-population, emplacement-history, nuisance, and survey-selection generative family. It is not the universal proposition that Planet X is absent.
required_model_families.matching_rule: Use the same primordial population, giant-planet history, Galactic tides, stellar encounters, early-cluster assumptions, observation epoch, nuisance structure, and analysis pipeline as M1 except for the registered additional compact body.

required_model_families.semantics: The M0 pipeline plus one additional compact body drawn from a finite, predeclared mass, orbit, phase, epoch, and uncertainty grid or prior. It does not represent every possible Planet X configuration.
required_model_families.matching_rule: Every non-compact-body initial condition, force, nuisance, survey, fitting, and scoring choice must match M0 or be jointly varied by a prelocked rule.

candidate_family_sources_for_later_lock.requirements: Acquire a content-addressed correlated posterior or define a justified finite grid, then lock mass, all orbital elements, phase, epoch, frame, origin, weights, and selection lineage.
Lock the exact exclusion data, brightness relation, conditioning rule, and multiplicity consequences without using the survey-scoring outcomes.
If included, freeze it as a separate multiplicity-controlled family with its own physically matched M0 counterpart and power region.
If included, define a separate family and do not describe a past transient perturber as a surviving Planet X.

candidate_selection_lineage.same_tno_data_reuse_rule: A model, grid point, or candidate selected using an observed TNO cannot treat that same object as independent confirmation.
candidate_selection_lineage.candidate_9118_rule: Candidate 9118 may be one declared grid point only if its full selection lineage is audited; it cannot stand for the M1 family or all Planet X parameter space.

unresolved_execution_blockers: Choose and justify a finite M1 family without using a future holdout outcome.
Build or acquire a physical source-population generator for both matched model families.
Freeze all model, nuisance, epoch, frame, force, integration, grid, prior, and weighting fields.
Audit candidate and grid selection lineage, including any use of the observed TNO catalog.
Define a scientifically justified core alternative region for realistic power calibration.
Acquire content-addressed model artifacts and independent implementation inputs.
nonclaim: This manifest defines neutral model-family requirements but contains no executable physical model and no evidence for or against Planet X.
